source.collection: Owner upload 2026-09-25: folder 'leeson Quiz/grade 6 quiz' (8 PDF files, Grade 6 only)
source.rule: Every quiz PDF is stored byte-for-byte. The sha256 below must match the stored copy and the owner's original file; nothing is regenerated, rewritten or renamed inside the document.

grades.title: Grade 6
grades.topicOrder: The uploaded files carry no numbering of their own, so the topics follow the Missouri Grade 6 strand order already used by MathNexa Online Math Prep: ratios and proportional relationships, number sense, expressions/equations/inequalities, geometry and measurement, data and statistics.

quiz.title: Ratios And Rates Practice

quiz.description: Success criteria: Write and simplify ratios from given quantities. Calculate and compare unit rates in context. Solve real-world multi-step rate problems. Answers are included on the final page.
quiz.answerKeyNote: The final page of the same PDF is headed 'Answers'.
